prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-16, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-04-16):
| Return 3m            | +41.3% |
| Return 1m            | +8.2% |
| Return 1w            | +4.9% |
| Range position (63d) | 87% |
| 21d realized vol     | 44% |
| Last close           | 39.92 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown strong momentum with a +41.3% 3-month rise and +8.2% in the last month, but it sits near the upper end of a ~63-day range (87% range position) with elevated realized volatility (~44%). Given the sharp run and proximity to range resistance, near-term upside may be limited and downside risk could materialize.

DECISION: HOLD
